title: caleya minor
intro: Caleya minor, commonly known as the minor caleya or minor bush, is a shrub native to Australia, belonging to the family Rutaceae. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties and has been used in traditional herbal medicine to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Caleya minor include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which can help soothe skin irritations, reduce fever, and protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to exhibit bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which contribute to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory effects.
